turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, you're through to Acme Life, my name's Hassan. Before we go any further, I should let you know this call is recorded for training and quality purposes. How can I help today?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Hi, yeah, I saw your advert online for life cover and thought I'd give you a ring. We've just got the keys to our first place, so it's been on my list.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Congratulations on the new home! Happy to help. Before I look at anything personal or a quote, can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Sure, it's James Walker. Date of birth is the 14th of March, 1992.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thanks, James Walker, 14th March 1992. That's lovely. So, tell me a bit about your situation. You mentioned the mortgage. What's prompting you to look at cover now?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Well, it's a joint mortgage with my partner, Sophie. About £210,000 over 25 years. The broker mentioned we should think about protection, and honestly I just don't want her stuck with the whole thing if something happened to me.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That makes complete sense. Do you have any children or anyone else depending on your income?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Not yet. Maybe in a few years. It's mainly about the mortgage really.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Okay. And do you have any existing life cover, maybe through work?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: There's a death-in-service thing at work, two times salary I think, but if I left the job that's gone, isn't it?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That's right, it's usually tied to your employment. So a personal policy would sit alongside it and stay with you if you move jobs. Given the mortgage is around £210,000 over 25 years, something in that region would make sense. Our cover ranges from £25,000 up to £500,000, so we can match it to what you need.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Okay. Do I need to go and see a doctor or anything? I've heard some of these need a medical.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: No medical exam with this one. Acceptance is based on a few health questions I'd ask you. Would you be happy to go through those now?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Yeah, go on.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Do you smoke or have you used any nicotine products in the last 12 months?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: No, never smoked.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: In the last five years, have you been diagnosed with or treated for any heart condition, cancer, diabetes or stroke?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: No, nothing like that. I had a knee operation from football a couple of years back, does that count?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thanks for mentioning it. That's not one of the conditions in the question, so it doesn't affect this. Last one: are you currently awaiting any tests, results or referrals?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Great. Based on that, for £210,000 of cover over 25 years, the premium comes out at £39 a month.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Hmm. That's a bit more than I was expecting. Does that go up as I get older?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: No, the premium is fixed for the whole length of the policy, so it'd be £39 a month for the full 25 years.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Right, that's useful to know. Is there any catch? Like stuff it doesn't pay out for?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: The main thing to be aware of is that in the first 12 months, only accidental death is covered. So if you passed away from an illness in that first year, it wouldn't pay out. After 12 months, you're covered in full.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Okay. I'm not mad about that first-year bit, to be honest.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That's fair, and it's worth weighing up. It's the trade-off for not needing a medical exam. If you'd like to think it over, or talk it through with Sophie, that's absolutely fine. The quote's there whenever you're ready.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: I did chat to her before I rang, she said if it's around forty quid just go for it. What if I sign up and change my mind?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: You'd have a 30-day cooling-off period. If you cancel within that, you get a full refund of anything you've paid.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Okay, that makes me feel better. Yeah, let's do it.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Lovely. Before I set it up, let me just summarise so you're clear. It's Acme Life Cover for £210,000 over 25 years, at £39 a month, fixed for the whole term. No medical exam, accepted on the health questions you answered. In the first 12 months only accidental death is covered, then full cover after that. And you've got 30 days to cancel for a full refund. Are you happy to go ahead on that basis?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Yes, I'm happy to go ahead.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Brilliant. I'll take your bank details for the Direct Debit next, and you'll get your policy documents by email within a couple of days.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Perfect. Thanks, Hassan, that was easier than I thought.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: My pleasure, James. Right, let's get those payment details sorted.
